title: James Dyer talks about the feeling of friendship and denial in new single “No Wiser”
htmlContent:
James Dyer's latest single, "No Wiser," is a genuine and thoughtful song that explores the ups and downs of friendship and the difficult feelings that come with watching someone struggle. Dyer wrote, produced, and performed the whole track himself, showcasing his talent as a solo artist and creating a genuine sound that connects deeply.

In "No Wiser," Dyer expresses the frustration of being a friend who wants to help but feels blocked by the person's refusal to accept it. The song tells a story of helplessness, emphasizing the struggle of seeing a loved one in trouble while unable to reach out to them.

https://open.spotify.com/track/4gX5TXVfaKd5ZKgrEMUh1F?si=7U_kcgs3S7akCjJJ40vTTQ

Dyer's clear vocals at the forefront deliver an honest message. His voice strikes a great balance between being vulnerable and strong. His second solo single, "No Wiser," shows that James Dyer is an artist to look out for. His ability to address deep emotions through his music makes him stand out.
